title: MT5 Strategy Backtester
description: Replay any MrMarket EA logic on MT5 history exported to CSV. Prints equity curve, drawdown, win rate and a trade list you can open in Excel.

title: Position Size Calculator
description: Command-line and GUI calculator: account size, risk %, stop distance in points, contract size, result in lots. Supports forex, metals, indices and crypto CFDs.

title: Trade Journal Exporter
description: Pulls closed deals from MT5 and writes a tagged Excel journal with per-strategy P&L, R multiples, time-of-day stats and a monthly summary sheet.

title: Telegram Signal Bridge
description: Forwards every EA entry, exit and error from the MT5 Experts log to a Telegram channel or private chat, with chart screenshot attached.

title: Equity Curve Analyser
description: Reads a backtest or live report and plots equity, underwater curve, rolling Sharpe and Monte Carlo drawdown bands so you know what to expect before going live.

title: Economic Calendar Filter
description: Downloads the week's high-impact events and writes a pause-window file the MrMarket EAs read, so strategies stand aside around NFP, CPI and rate decisions.
requirements: Python 3.10+, internet access on the VPS
